senses.gloss: m. (Hebr. denom. of Ch. ) porraceous (of color), leek-green stuff.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:2">Ber. I, 2</cite> (<he>משיכיר</he>) <he>בין תכלת לכ׳</he> when one can distinguish between blue and green; (Y. ed. <cite ref="K01292"><he>כְרֵתָן</he></cite>; Ar. Var. <cite ref="K01283"><he>כרתא</he></cite>, <cite ref="K01283"><he>כרתה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:6">Succ. III, 6</cite> <he>הירוק ככ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>ככרתן</he>) an Ethrog green like a porraceous plant (v. <cite ref="K01290"><he>כְּרֵתִינוֹן</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Gittin 31b:12">Gitt. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>סרבלא דכ׳</he> a cloak of green wool.
